newsitem.title: USA: Philippines buys about 40,000 T US wheat - trade.
newsitem.headline: Philippines buys about 40,000 T US wheat - trade.

text.p: The Philippines early this week bought about 40,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat slated for November 24-December 19 arrival, U.S. exporters said.
"On Monday night, the Phillippines bought about 40,000 tonnes U.S. wheat, which included western white and spring wheat," a trader at a U.S.-based Japanese export firm said.

One U.S. exporter said the purchase included 17,040 tonnes of western white wheat, 16,900 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat and 6,000 tonnes dark northern spring 14.0 percent protein, out of the Pacific Northwest.
